pagePinning.errorTitle: The pinned announcement could not be read
pagePinning.errorBody: Publications remain available below. Read the announcement again before changing the pin.
pagePinning.pinDescription: This publication will appear at the top of the page wall for people who can read it.
pagePinning.unpinDescription: The publication will remain on the page wall. Only its pin will be removed.
pagePinning.replaceWarning: An announcement is already pinned. This publication will replace it at the top of the wall; the previous announcement will remain published.
pagePinning.audienceKept: The publication’s audience stays the same. This action does not republish it or send a notification.
pagePinning.changedSinceOpening: The pin has changed since this window opened. Close this window and reopen it to confirm from the new reading.
pagePinning.readRequired: The current pin must be available before you can confirm. Your choice is kept in this window.

errors.page_pin_changed: The pin has changed in the meantime. Close this window and reopen it to read the current version before confirming.
